files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
A TOTP quick button in the list, plus a round of standalone-page polish.

### Added
- Entries with a one-time code get a fourth quick button in the list (next to the globe, user and key): it copies the current TOTP code.

### Changed
- Standalone page: the note on the unlock screen only says that the server sees just the encrypted file. The offline copy promise is dropped there, since it only holds with a Nextcloud or WebDAV connection.
- The three dots of the "More" buttons (entry, folders, tags) are bold enough to be seen.
- Standalone page: the tagline breaks after "in the browser -".
- Generator page: on tall screens the generator sits around the middle of the page instead of at the very top.
- Password generator: the "Simple" field is as tall as the "Password" one, so the layout no longer jumps when switching tabs.
- Generator page: English and German only, English by default; the title uses the shield without a tile, like the unlock view in Nextcloud.
- Standalone page: the shield sits without a tile next to the name, on the login and in the top bar of an open database.
- Standalone page: the tagline says "in the browser" instead of "in Nextcloud", and a new line points to the app in the Nextcloud App Store.
